description: Source code for a DirectoryScanner class that performs recursive directory scanning, file parsing, batching, embedding creation, and data upsertion for code indexing in a VSCode extension environment.

classes.name: DirectoryScanner
classes.description: A class responsible for recursively scanning directories, parsing code files, batching data, creating embeddings, and updating a vector store for code indexing.

methods.name: scanDirectory
methods.description: Recursively scans a directory for supported code files, parses them, batches code blocks, and updates the vector store, with support for cancellation and error handling.

methods.name: processBatch
methods.description: Processes a batch of code blocks: deletes outdated points, creates embeddings, upserts points into the vector store, and updates cache hashes, with retries and error handling.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Requests cooperative cancellation of ongoing directory scanning.

methods.name: isCancelled
methods.description: Returns whether the scan has been cancelled.

methods.name: updateBatchSegmentThreshold
methods.description: Updates the batch segment size threshold.
